Here’s a list of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (i.e., public holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, creating a three‑day weekend). Dates are shown in the format **YYYY‑MM‑DD**.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | 2023‑01‑01 | Sunday | Observed on Monday, 2023‑01‑02 |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | 2023‑02‑20 | Monday | Observed on Monday, 2023‑02‑20 |
| Good Friday | 2023‑04‑07 | Friday | |
| Easter Monday (Newfoundland & Labrador, Prince Edward Island) | 2023‑04‑10 | Monday | |
| Victoria Day | 2023‑05‑22 | Monday | |
| Canada Day | 2023‑07‑01 | Saturday | Observed on Monday, 2023‑07‑03 |
| Labour Day | 2023‑09‑04 | Monday | |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | 2023‑10‑09 | Monday | |
| Remembrance Day (observed) | 2023‑11‑11 | Saturday | Observed on Monday, 2023‑11‑13 |
| Christmas Day | 2023‑12‑25 | Monday | |
| Boxing Day | 2023‑12‑26 | Tuesday | |

### How to use this list

1. **Identify your province/territory** – some holidays (e.g., Family Day, Remembrance Day) are observed only in certain provinces.
2. **Check for observed dates** – if a holiday falls on a weekend, the official observed day may be the following Monday (or preceding Friday).
3. **Plan your trips** – combine these long weekends with travel days to maximize vacation time.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province or if you need additional details such as regional variations!
